The prescribed format may be obtained from the c oncerned office. 3. 3.The service provider must possess Experience Certificates, GeM Portal Work Orders, and Selection /Acceptance Orders. These documents shall also be displayed at the work site. 4. 4.The Buyer shall verify all documents submitted by the bidder. Any complaint or objection received after closure of the bid or at the time of bid opening shall not be con sidered. 7. 8.The bidder/service provider institution must have prior experience of at least 03 (three) similar wo rks. As proof of such experience, a GeM Work Order for each work must be submitted. 8. 9.No tender shall be considered without the required Security/Earnest Money Deposit.If, for any rea son, payment is not made to the bidder by the Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Palika Parishad, 9. 10.the bidder shall bear the financial responsibility for payment related to the work.Statutory deduc

tions shall be made from the bill payment as per applicable rules, and the bidder shall accept such d eductions. 10. 11.All bid documents, along with the EMD of ₹86,500/- submitted/uploaded while participating in the bid, must also be physically submitted to the Buyer’s office within 5 days from the Bid End Date/Bid Opening Date. Failure to submit the required documents and EMD within the stipulated time may re sult in rejection of the bid. 11. The bidder is required to submit the PAN Card, GST Certificate along with the Current GST Return, A adhaar Card, and other required documents along with the bid. 12. Any Gazetted Officer who is/was working in an administrative department of the State Government or Central Government shall be prohibited from undertaking contractual work for a period of two ye ars after retirement without prior permission of the Government. If it is found that the contractor or his/her representative has not obtained the required prior permission from the State Government b efore submitting the bid, or has started working with the bidder without such permission, the contra ct may be cancelled. 13. In the event of any untoward incident involving any vehicle driver/employee during execution of the work, the entire responsibility shall lie with the service provider. 14. If the service provider fails to pay employees on time or fails to deposit employees’ Provident Fund as per applicable rules, or if vehicle drivers/employees go on strike or stage any protest, the service provider shall be solely responsible. 15. A declaration regarding the benefit/profit under each applicable scheme shall be submitted along wi th the bid documents. 16. The firm’s registered GSTN and office must be located within the State of Uttar Pradesh. 17. Experience in the same category shall be given preference. 18. If the performance of the executing agency remains satisfactory, the agency may be considered for the work again in the future. 19. Conditional tenders shall not be considered. 20. The Chairman, Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Palika Parishad, shall have the right to accept or reject any t ender without assigning any reason. 21. The bidder/service provider must possess a valid Labour Certificate issued/registered in Uttar Prade sh, wherever applicable. 22. Any bidder shall not be eligible to participate in the bidding process if the bidder himself/herself or a ny of his/her close relatives, including first blood relations or spouse, is employed in any capacity in the Nagar Palika Parishad, Nagar Panchayat, or Forest Corporation, Uttar Pradesh. The bidder shall u pload a notarized affidavit in this regard. 23. The bidder shall upload a notarized affidavit declaring that he/she has not been blacklisted by any Government Department, has no criminal record, neither the bidder nor any of its partners/directors is enrolled with any Bar Council, and that the bidder maintains good reputation and conduct with Go vernment Departments as on the Bid Effective Date. 24. The bidder shall upload a declaration on ₹100/- non-judicial stamp paper, duly notarized, certifying t he correctness and authenticity of all information, declarations, and documents submitted with the bid. The bidder shall also submit the original hard copy of the declaration to the Buyer within 5 days from the Bid End Date/Bid Opening Date. 25. The supply of all items/materials related to the bid shall be completed on or before 15-11-2026 fro m the date of issuance of the Work Order. 26. The bidder shall confirm acceptance of all terms and conditions of the bid. Such confirmation shall b e uploaded on the bidder’s letterhead, and the bidder shall submit the hard copy to the Buyer within 5 days from the Bid End Date/Bid Opening Date. 27. If the bidder fails to upload any required document, or uploads an unreadable, incomplete, or uncle ar scanned copy, the bidder shall be disqualified. .
